message.content:
The first image is a cold tile corridor, a door standing open like a waiting mouth. 🚪
A white coat trembles at the threshold, and the air smells of bleach and old fear. 🧼
Hale, the doctor, enters with a paper cup of silver-blue pills, his shadow long behind him. 💊
Lira, the schizophrenic patient, sits in a chair, her eyes bright as broken glass. 🪟
Hale orders Lira to take her daily pills. 💊
Lira refuses, and her small hand becomes a wall against the cup. ✋
She challenges him to swallow one pill to prove they are safe. 🍬
The fluorescent lights crack, and the whole room begins to breathe like a trapped bird. 🐦
Hale hesitates, but he opens the cup and chooses a single blue pill. 💊
He places the pill on his tongue, and the room tilts into a spiral of hospital bells. 🔔
He closes his eyes, and the asylum folds into a dream of endless white hallways. 😴
He opens his eyes, and Lira is gone. 👻
The chair is empty, and the floor holds only a faint outline of someone who was never there. 🪑
A monitor flickers and shows that Hale's dosage is overdue. 💉
A nurse enters with a chart, and the chart is labeled with Hale's name. 📋
He hears his own name repeated down the hall, and each voice wears a white coat. 🧑‍⚕️
The empty chair becomes a mirror, and his reflected face wears the calm of a patient. 🪞
The asylum dissolves into a waiting room where every chair holds another version of him. 🛋️
The chart, the empty cup, and the white coat all prove that Hale, the doctor, has been the schizophrenic patient all along. 📋
He is the one who refuses the pills, and the pills are the only safe door. 🚪
The white coat peels away, leaving him in a hospital gown with thin wrists and numbered skin. 🏥
The real doctor enters and reminds Hale that his own medicine is waiting. 💊
The final image is a closed door, and behind it, an empty cup glimmers like a moon with no water. 🌙
